adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and updates creation logic, but introduces incorrect calendar selection and loses external calendar IDs in some paths. In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)`, the calendarId is chosen via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, falling back to `"primary"` when not found; if destination entries have `credentialId` null/undefined, this will not match any credential and will insert into primary even if a destination `externalId` exists. Separately, `CalendarManager.createEvent` now returns `{ externalId }` from its new optional argument, and `EventManager` stores booking references using `externalCalendarId: result.externalId`; however in `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when `destination.credentialId` is falsy it calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId`, so `result.externalId` will be `undefined` and references will omit `externalCalendarId`. Finally, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` can create duplicates: for each destination lacking `credentialId`, it iterates *all* credentials of `destination.integration` and creates events, and if multiple such destinations exist (e.g., collective team members) this repeats per destination, multiplying events.
